title: Listening to the Choir
text: The Sensor Mast catches what the tower has been broadcasting all along: the code wall, read aloud, on a loop. Under it runs a second signal, very slow. Eleven pulses. A long gap. Eleven pulses again.

lines.text: "0201 ELEVEN CLOSED. 0202 ONE OPEN. 0203 WE COUNT SO THAT SOMEONE COUNTS."
